D0.name: LOCAL_QUOTIENT_CONTROL
D0.algorithm: canonicalize the two local transport records and emit only the resulting local summary

D1.name: ELABORATED_LOCAL_DERIVATIVE_CONTROL
D1.algorithm: emit the full frozen deterministic local-derived feature tuple together with the canonical local summary

algorithm.UNKNOWN: if coverage == UNKNOWN emit state UNKNOWN and fact null
algorithm.ALIAS_TOKEN_PROBE: compare phase12_token with phase23_token; equal => INTERACTION_PRESENT/ALIASED_WITH_AUTHORITY_SENSITIVE_COLLISION, unequal => INTERACTION_ABSENT/DISJOINT
algorithm.ORDER_REVERSAL_PROBE: compare forward_authority_state with reverse_authority_state; unequal => INTERACTION_PRESENT/NONCOMMUTATIVE_AUTHORITY_GUARD_FLIP, equal => INTERACTION_ABSENT/COMMUTES_ON_AUTHORITY_RELEVANT_STATE
algorithm.EFFECT_TRACE_PROBE: scan writes for exact target J3.admissibility_state; present => INTERACTION_PRESENT/WRITE_ALTERS_J3_ADMISSIBILITY_STATE, absent => INTERACTION_ABSENT/NO_WRITE_TO_J3_ADMISSIBILITY_STATE
algorithm.COMPOSED_PRECONDITION_PROBE: compare j2_post_quota with j3_required_quota_min; lower => INTERACTION_PRESENT/COMPOSED_PRECONDITION_VIOLATION, otherwise => INTERACTION_ABSENT/COMPOSED_PRECONDITION_SATISFIED

D3.name: CORRESPONDENCE_DESTROYED_PROBE_CONTROL
D3.input_multiset: exact eight primary raw probes from WORLDS.json
